benefit_text: The scheme pays a monthly pension. It pays 200 rupees up to 79 years. It pays 500 rupees after that.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be citizens of India. They must live Below Poverty Line. They must be at least 60 years of age.
documents: Important papers are Aadhar Number and Bank Passbook. Ration Card and age proof are also needed. A filled application form is needed.
how_to_apply: Applications are online through UMANG App. Citizens login with mobile number and OTP. Citizens search for NSAP and fill basic details with photo.
